# velin-lazy

Lazy-load images with optional skeleton.

## Values
| Value | Meaning | Bridges to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (empty / present) | Lazy-load `<img>` (`loading="lazy"`) | Native lazy + optional skeleton |
## Example

```html
<div velin-lazy>…</div>
```

## Accessibility

Adds `loading="lazy"` on `<img>` only.
